mr_title: Fix a potential fd leak in AbstractDiskHttpData.getChunk
mr_description:
Motivation:

`FileChannel.read()` may throw an IOException. We must deal with this in case of the occurrence of `I/O` error.

Modification:

Place the `FileChannel.read()` method call in the `try-finally` block.

Result:

Advoid fd leak.

expected_issues.title: File channel closed after every chunk, so reads restart from the start
expected_issues.description:
getChunk() now closes and nulls the FileChannel in a finally block after every call, so the next chunk re-opens the file from position 0 and multi-chunk reads return the beginning of the file again (corrupted uploads/copies).

getChunk(length) is called repeatedly to stream a file; the channel was intentionally kept open between calls and closed only at EOF. To fix a descriptor leak on IOException, the change closes it unconditionally, which resets the read position on each call. The channel must only be closed on EOF or when an exception is thrown.
